A disk-full or permission error therefore replaces FailStop with an I/O exception, skipping the intended fail-stop path that keeps admission held. Diagnostic persistence must not mask the control-flow failure; attempt the write without allowing its exception to suppress FailStop, while retaining the normal successful-drain recording path.
